work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: The act authorizes the Belgian bishops to erect perpetual-adoration confraternities with Clement XIII's indulgences. Issuer evidence GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF9743; own dating clause LF9798–9801 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem sub annulo piscatoris die vigesima sexta septembris millesimo’ octingentesimo trigesimo primo, pontificatus Nostri anno primo.. Own provenance note LF9831 excluded as edition furniture. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
